sources: Flare 2.0 练后 专项补强 + Flare2 2026-11-21（Google 表 1aCseEk4vslsG-QKb-zsZwg30amvoYh5tMxzy6p9n8vA，练后专项补强：前臂侧桥（直腿））

purpose.zh: 直腿侧桥，练身体侧面和肩膀的支撑力，让单手和侧向支撑更稳
purpose.en: A straight-leg side plank on the forearm. Builds side-body and shoulder strength for one-arm and sideways supports.

text.zh: 手肘在肩正下方，髋抬高，头到脚一条线
text.en: Elbow under shoulder, hips high, one line

text.zh: 侧躺，前臂撑地朝前，双腿伸直并拢。
text.en: On your side, forearm on the mat pointing forward, legs straight and together.

text.zh: 胸口朝正前方，不往前扑也不往后倒。
text.en: Chest faces straight ahead, not rolling forward or back.

text.zh: 上面的手臂伸直指向天花板，或扶在髋上。
text.en: Top arm straight up to the ceiling, or hand on the hip.

commonErrors.en: Elbow too far from under the shoulder.
Shoulder shrugging up and the head dropping.

cautions.zh: 肩膀疼就改成屈膝侧桥
cautions.en: If your shoulder hurts, switch to the bent-knee side plank.

flare2.item: 练后专项补强：前臂侧桥（直腿）
flare2.camera: 正前略偏（看得到肘在肩下、髋高度和头到脚一条线）
flare2.doseBrief: 表：静态每侧 20 秒；草稿 1 组（组数待定）；动画左侧着地示范，App 镜像
flare2.note: Animation r3: left side down, left forearm flat forward, elbow under the shoulder (sandbox 0.1 cm), legs straight and stacked, right arm to the ceiling; static 8 s loop. One side shown, the app mirrors.

set.zh: 手肘在肩膀正下方，前臂朝前
set.en: Elbow right under the shoulder, forearm forward

set.zh: 髋往上顶，头到脚一条直线
set.en: Hips up, one straight line from head to feet

set.zh: 胸口朝正前方，肩膀离耳朵远一点
set.en: Chest facing forward, shoulder away from your ear

sides.note: 先左侧着地，再右侧；换边准备 10 秒（training.sideSwitchSeconds，App 未接入）
